targets.startup_or_first_response: Define a measurable first-use or first-response target before implementation.
targets.steady_state_latency: Document acceptable latency for the primary workflow.
targets.resource_budget: Set explicit CPU, memory, network, storage, or bundle-size limits when relevant.
targets.failure_recovery: Define timeout, retry, fallback, and degraded-mode behavior.
targets.observability: Identify the minimum signals needed to detect performance drift.

review_rule: Budgets are constraints for the Vertical Blueprint; override only with rationale and rejected alternative.
